verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's Session Replay docs say you can follow up on funnel analysis by "exploring why customers drop off," which implies a link from drop-off to replays. The marketing site also mentions saving replay playlists filtered by events or properties, which could cover error events. Neither source documents a direct, one-click jump from a specific funnel step or error event to the affected users' replays. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented funnel-step-to-replay drill-down, error-event-to-replay linking, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
